name: cloud-image-import
command: ssh -i "$CAPSTONE_SSH_KEY" -o UserKnownHostsFile="$CAPSTONE_KNOWN_HOSTS" -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -o ConnectTimeout=15 -o BatchMode=yes student@"$CAPSTONE_VM_IP" 'sudo k3s ctr -n k8s.io images import /tmp/homework-tracker-images.tar.gz && sudo k3s ctr -n k8s.io images ls | grep homework-tracker'
